heading.en: 1-1 Day | Int. The Quinn family mansion, living room
heading.zh: 1-1 Day | Int. The Quinn family mansion, living room

en: The cream-and-gold living room in daylight. Natalie sits in the armchair in the foreground centre with her back to the camera. George sits at frame left and Lauren at frame right on the cream sofa in front of the arched windows, with the glass coffee table between them and Natalie.
The hospital statement lies on the glass coffee table, its bold total at the bottom.
Lauren's shoulder and hair fill the foreground edge. Natalie in the armchair leans slightly forward toward her father, hands clasped, eyes hopeful.
Only Natalie, framed tight on her face and shoulders; her eyes glisten as she pleads.
George at the fireplace end of the sofa, frame left, rubs his hands together and glances right at Lauren beside him at frame right.
Lauren uncrosses her legs and fixes Natalie, toward the camera, with a cold stare, lip curled.

heading.en: 1-1 Day | Int. The Quinn family mansion, living room
heading.zh: 1-1 Day | Int. The Quinn family mansion, living room

en: Cassie appears in the open double doorway at frame right with a mocking pout. Natalie in the foreground armchair, and George and Lauren on the sofa, all turn their heads right toward her.
Cassie strolls across the rug from the doorway and stops beside the armchair on its doorway side, frame right of Natalie, standing over the seated Natalie.
Cassie looks down at Natalie with a smirk, one hand on her hip.
Only Natalie, framed tight on her face; she lowers her eyes, her jaw tightening.
Natalie picks up the hospital statement from the coffee table and rises from the armchair; Cassie, at the armchair's frame-right side, steps back half a pace toward the doorway.
Natalie walks past Cassie toward the double doorway, the statement in her hand, and stops a few steps short of the doorway.

Lauren at frame right nods firmly beside George at frame left.
Lauren turns left to George and pats his knee.
Only Lauren, framed tight on her face; she looks back toward Natalie with a thin mauve-lipped smile.

heading.zh: 2-1 Day | Int. Jail, a cell

en: The blocky grey concrete jail building behind a tall chain-link fence topped with coils of razor wire, under a clear sky.
Sebastian lies on the steel bunk along the left wall, his back to the barred cell door, facing the grey-green wall, a shaft of daylight slanting down from the barred high window.
Officer steps up to the barred cell door from the dim corridor, grips a steel bar with one hand and glares toward the bunk.
Sebastian lies facing the wall with his eyes open, calm, and does not turn around; the Officer is off screen.
Officer bangs his key ring hard against the steel bars of the cell door, his face red and furious.

Sebastian rolls over toward the barred cell door and slowly sits up on the edge of the steel bunk, his feet in the white slip-on canvas shoes on the floor, while the Officer stands at the barred door with his hand on the bars.

heading.zh: 2-2 Day | Int. Jail, front desk

en: Sebastian fastens the steel-and-black wristwatch around his wrist while the Officer picks up the release form on a clipboard from the desk and holds it out to him over the counter.
Officer points the ballpoint pen at Sebastian, frowning under his bushy moustache.
Sebastian's hand, the wristwatch now on it, takes the release form on a clipboard and the black ballpoint pen; the Officer is off screen.
Sebastian raises his eyes from the clipboard to the Officer with a cocky smirk.
Sebastian signs the release form on the clipboard with a flourish and a smile, while the Officer behind the desk shakes his head.

heading.en: 2-3 Day | Ext. Street outside the jail
heading.zh: 2-3 Day | Ext. Street outside the jail

en: Sebastian walks out through the steel pedestrian gate onto the sunny sidewalk, squints at the sky and straightens his shirt collar with both hands.
The black expensive car waits at the curb with Daniel standing beside its rear passenger door, hands folded; Sebastian walks along the sidewalk toward him.
Daniel opens the rear passenger door of the car; Sebastian stops at the open door, facing Daniel, one hand resting on the door frame.
Daniel gives a crisp nod behind his rimless glasses.
Daniel, holding the open car door, leans in slightly toward Sebastian and lowers his voice.
Sebastian adjusts his wristwatch and a slow, satisfied smirk spreads across his face; Daniel is off screen.

heading.en: 2-3 Day | Ext. Street outside the jail

en: Sebastian taps the top of the open car door with his fingers and tilts his head at Daniel.
Daniel straightens his glasses, standing by the open car door, and looks Sebastian in the eye.
Sebastian looks off toward the jail fence and his smirk widens.
Sebastian leans in close and whispers into Daniel's ear, a hand on Daniel's shoulder; Daniel listens with his eyes narrowing, then nods.

heading.en: 3-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue
heading.zh: 3-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue

en: Tall crystal flutes of pale golden champagne stand on the silver tray on the white cocktail table, catching the sunlight, with the boxwood hedge out of focus behind them.

Natalie stands under the flower-hung arch with the bouquet and George stands beside her on the rose-bush side. The space on her other side is empty. Lauren stands at the front row of chairs in the foreground, turned toward them.
Under the arch, George turns toward Natalie with a nervous, placating smile and pats her arm once.
Natalie turns her face to George, her eyes steady and serious above the veil.
George drops his gaze and glances toward Lauren at the front row, avoiding his daughter's eyes.
Lauren turns her wrist and checks her slim gold wristwatch with an impatient tap of one finger.

en: Guest 2 and Guest 1 stand at the round white cocktail table in front of the hedge, flutes in hand, and lean their heads together.
Guest 2 shields her mouth with her flute and glances toward the arch, eyes wide.
Guest 1 nods eagerly and rolls her eyes, swirling her champagne.
Guest 2 leans closer, lowering her voice, her freckled face lit with relish.
Guest 1 takes a sip from her flute and smirks over its rim toward the empty side of the arch.
Guest 2 covers a giggle with her hand while Guest 1 clinks her flute against Guest 2's flute.

en: Cassie struts from the stone garden wall to the head of the aisle, arms crossed, and stops a step in front of Natalie on the rose-bush side, facing her. Natalie's veil and shoulder appear at the frame edge.
Cassie tilts her head with a sugary, mocking smile, her gold hoops swinging.
Natalie lowers her eyes to the bouquet and presses her lips together.
Cassie glances at the empty side of the arch and gives a fake pout.
Cassie leans in toward Natalie's ear with a cruel, gleeful grin.
George winces, opens his mouth, then closes it and looks away toward the guests.

en: Sebastian's black patent oxfords step off the gravel path onto the start of the petal-strewn aisle runner.

Sebastian walks up the aisle between the white chairs toward the arch with an unhurried stride, straightening his shirt cuff, a calm half-smile on his face. He ends halfway up the aisle.
Guest 1's mouth falls open and her eyes follow Sebastian along the aisle.
Sebastian reaches the front row of chairs on the boxwood-hedge side, where Lauren stands in his path, and gives her a polite, lazy nod.
Lauren steps back against the front-row chair, her eyes widening as she looks him up and down, one hand rising to her pearl necklace.

heading.en: 4-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue

en: Natalie, bouquet at her waist, faces Sebastian under the flower-hung arch, with George beside her on the rose-bush side and the Officiant behind them. Cassie, a step in front of Natalie, tips the empty white gift box toward her with a smirk; Lauren stands against the front-row chair on the hedge side, and Guest 1 and Guest 2 watch from the cocktail table by the hedge with their flutes.

Lauren, leaning against the front-row chair on the hedge side, looks Natalie up and down and arches a brow; behind her, out of focus, Guest 1 and Guest 2 stand at the cocktail table with their flutes.
Natalie, under the arch, turns her head toward Lauren and holds her stepmother's eyes with a level, cold gaze.
Sebastian, on the hedge side of the arch, leans slightly toward Natalie with a lazy, amused half-smile, the back of Natalie's veil in the foreground.
Natalie, bouquet still at her waist, looks up at Sebastian and a small smile breaks across her face.
The Officiant, hands clasped, looks from Natalie to Sebastian; their shoulders show at both frame edges.

Sebastian steps back out of Cassie's reach to Natalie's side and glances at Natalie; Cassie's hand closes on air and she backs off toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side.
At the cocktail table by the hedge, Guest 2 laughs into her champagne glass while Guest 1 beside her, flute in hand, covers a grin.
Cassie's smile drops; she flushes and glares toward the cocktail table, her fingers tightening on the gift box.
Natalie, under the arch, turns toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side and holds out her palm; George beside her grips the bouquet.
Lauren's hands clutch her small handbag tight against her hip, her diamond ring flashing.

heading.en: 4-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue

en: At the cocktail table by the hedge, Guest 1 sets her flute on the silver tray, pulls her pink phone from her clutch and raises it vertically toward the family to record, and Guest 2 leans in beside her with her champagne glass.
Lauren, at the front-row chair on the hedge side, spins toward the cocktail table and jabs a finger at Guest 1, Cassie beside her.
Sebastian, beside Natalie under the arch, spreads one hand toward the raised phone with a cool smile, his eyes on Lauren.
Natalie's eyes glisten and her jaw sets as she looks at Lauren.
George crosses from beside Natalie under the arch to Lauren's aisle side at the front-row chair, the bouquet in one hand, and grips her arm with the other, his face set.
Lauren pulls her phone in its lilac case from her handbag and stabs furiously at the banking transfer page with her thumb.

heading.en: 4-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue
heading.zh: 4-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue

en: Cassie's hands crush the empty white gift box into a crumpled shape, its ribbon twisting.
Lauren turns on her heel from the front-row chair and marches down the petal aisle toward the gravel path, her face rigid.

George lays the bouquet on the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side, and he, Cassie with the crumpled box, Guest 1 and Guest 2 hurry down the aisle after Lauren and out onto the gravel path, leaving Natalie, Sebastian and the Officiant alone under the arch.
Sebastian places the brass house key into Natalie's open palm.
Natalie, at the rose-bush end of the arch, looks from the key up to Sebastian with a puzzled frown.
Sebastian leans closer to Natalie with a slow, confident smile.

en: Natalie stops in the bedroom doorway in her wedding gown and looks into the single bedroom. Sebastian stands on the window side of the coffee table, watching her.
Natalie turns her head from the bedroom toward Sebastian, her brows raised.
Sebastian stands by the coffee table and tips his head toward the couch with a relaxed look.
Natalie folds her arms across her bodice and lifts her chin.
Sebastian picks up the blank sheet of paper and the blue pen from the coffee table and holds them out toward Natalie.

Natalie walks from the doorway to the couch, sets her bag on the floor at the kitchenette end, sits there, takes the paper and pen from Sebastian and leans over the coffee table. Sebastian stays on the window side of the table.

heading.en: 5-1 Night | Int. Sebastian's apartment, living room
heading.zh: 5-1 Night | Int. Sebastian's apartment, living room

en: Sebastian holds up two fingers, then lowers his hand to the coffee table.
Natalie's hand signs her name at the bottom of the handwritten agreement.
Sebastian takes the pen from Natalie, bends over the coffee table and signs beneath her name while she watches.
Natalie lifts her unfastened pale-blue bag from the floor and sets it on the coffee table, its top gaping open.
A folded pale-blush lace bra slips out of the open bag and lands on the signed agreement.
Natalie, cheeks flushing, quickly scoops the lace bra back into her bag.

en: Sebastian pulls off his bow tie and tuxedo jacket and drops them over the couch arm.

Across the cut, Sebastian now wears a fitted white ribbed undershirt and black lounge trousers; he settles onto the couch at its kitchenette end and sets his black phone face down on the coffee table beside the agreement.
The bedroom door opens and Natalie steps into the doorway, barefoot, in the powder-blue camisole and sleep shorts with the ivory robe hanging open.
Sebastian looks up from the couch toward the doorway, one arm along the couch back.
Natalie holds the door frame, her eyes fixed on him, nervous and determined.
Sebastian rises and walks to the bedroom door, stopping one step in front of Natalie.

en: Natalie gives him a last look and closes the bedroom door between them.
Sebastian walks from the closed bedroom door back to the couch and sits at its kitchenette end.
Sebastian's black phone lights up on the coffee table beside the signed agreement.
Sebastian picks up the phone and taps open the notification, his face turning calm and focused in its glow.
The phone screen shows the private-banking notification on its dark background, as in the prop reference.
Sebastian's hand slides the phone face down beneath the signed agreement.

heading.en: 6-1 Day | Int. Sebastian's apartment, living room
heading.zh: 6-1 Day | Int. Sebastian's apartment, living room

en: Sunlit living room. Natalie sets two plates of scrambled eggs, toast and strawberries on the round dining table. Sebastian, by the charcoal couch, shakes out the oatmeal-grey blanket and starts folding it.
Sebastian folds the blanket in half against his chest and looks across toward the dining table with a lazy half-smile.
Natalie sets a mug of black coffee beside a plate without looking up, her jaw set.
Sebastian's smile widens slightly; he drops the folded blanket onto the couch cushions.
Natalie lifts the long white dress bag off the back of the dining chair and drapes it over her left arm.
Natalie's shoulder and the dress bag fill the frame edge; Sebastian, beyond her by the couch, nods at the bag and raises an eyebrow.

en: Natalie walks to the front door on the left wall, takes the cropped ivory bouclé jacket off the wall hook and pulls it on over her dress, the dress bag still on her arm; Sebastian stays by the couch watching her.
Natalie, now in the open cropped jacket, opens the dark-grey front door, glances back once, steps out and the door swings shut behind her.
Sebastian walks to the round dining table and stops on its couch side, opening his hand over the table.
Sebastian's fingers set the two coins down beside his face-down phone.
Sebastian picks up the phone, taps it and lifts it to his ear; his lazy smile drops into a cold, focused look.
Sebastian speaks low into the phone, eyes fixed on the closed front door.

heading.zh: 6-2 Day | Int. Sebastian's apartment, living room

en: Daniel lays the manila folder on the round dining table in front of Sebastian, who sits in the dining chair.
Sebastian flips the folder open; a single creased sheet slides out onto the table.
The hospital statement lies on the table beside the open folder, its header and total legible.
Sebastian's shoulder at the frame edge; Daniel, across the table, adjusts his rimless glasses.
Daniel is off screen. Sebastian picks up the hospital statement and reads it, his jaw tightening.
Sebastian lowers the sheet, his steel-grey eyes hard.

en: Sebastian sits at the dining table; Daniel slips his phone away, takes a black car key fob from his pocket and sets it beside the two coins.
The black car key fob lies next to the two silver quarters.
Sebastian picks up the car key and turns it once between his fingers.
Daniel folds his hands in front of him, a faint doubtful look behind his glasses.
Sebastian gives a slow, private smile.
Sebastian's hand scoops the two coins off the table and slides them into his chino pocket.

logline.en: Five years after 纪宏远 drove away her first love, 纪然 refuses to be traded into a marriage with 路少泽 and holds an open audition for a husband. The late, rain-soaked 'college student' 林青羽 who walks in is secretly a boss in disguise, and the younger brother of her best friend Su Yaqing.
logline.zh: Five years after 纪宏远 drove away her first love, 纪然 refuses to be traded into a marriage with 路少泽 and holds an open audition for a husband. The late, rain-soaked 'college student' 林青羽 who walks in is secretly a boss in disguise, and the younger brother of her best friend Su Yaqing.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut desk with the windows glowing behind her. One hand is braced on the desk while she pours water from the kettle into the dripper. Her face is cold.
Water spirals from the kettle spout into the paper filter, and dark coffee drips into the glass server.
Ji Ran keeps pouring with her mouth closed, and her eyes lift coldly from the dripper.
Ji Ran sets the kettle down on the walnut desk and straightens, leaning on her braced hand with her mouth closed.
Ji Ran gives a thin, icy smile.
Ji Ran's fingers press down hard on the architectural plans beside the white coffee cup.

heading.zh: INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

en: Garden leaves sway in warm sunlight beyond the glass, casting dappled light.
Ji Hongyuan sits on the beige sofa. Lu Shaoze stands with his head bowed across the marble coffee table from him, and the document envelope lies between them.
Ji Hongyuan sweeps the document envelope off the marble table with the back of his hand, and it drops onto the ivory carpet at Lu Shaoze's feet.
Lu Shaoze's lowered head is in the foreground. Ji Hongyuan leans back on the sofa and stares at him with contempt.
Lu Shaoze keeps his eyes on the envelope on the carpet. His jaw tightens and his hands curl at his sides.
Ji Hongyuan points a ringed finger at Lu Shaoze.

en: Ji Ran raises the white coffee cup to her lips and sips.
Ji Ran lowers the cup with her mouth closed, staring past the office door with the windows bright behind her.
Ji Ran sets the white coffee cup down hard beside the glass server, and the coffee ripples.
Ji Ran's eyes narrow with her mouth closed, and her hand stays on the cup.
Ji Ran's gaze hardens into cold resolve, her mouth firmly closed.

heading.zh: INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM - DAY

en: Su Yaqing lounges on the cream sofa with her long legs crossed, smiling at the phone she holds up, mouth closed.
Su Yaqing's eyebrows rise and she stops smiling, mouth closed.
Su Yaqing leans forward toward the phone, her mouth falling open in surprise.
Su Yaqing's shoulder and curls fill the foreground, and the phone screen shows the video call.
Su Yaqing blinks twice, mouth closed, then her lips press against a laugh.
Su Yaqing bursts out laughing and slaps a pastel cushion beside her.

en: Su Yaqing's laughter fades. She nods slowly at the phone with her mouth closed.
Su Yaqing rolls her eyes with her mouth closed.
Su Yaqing tosses a pastel cushion aside and leans back, mouth closed.
Su Yaqing sits up straight, her eyes lighting up with an idea.
Su Yaqing tilts the phone closer to her face with a sly smile.
Su Yaqing wiggles her shoulders playfully in the foreground, and the video call glows on the phone screen.

Su Yaqing flops back into the pastel cushions with a sigh, mouth closed.
Su Yaqing purses her lips and shrugs, mouth closed.
Su Yaqing raises her free palm in mock surrender.
Su Yaqing's face softens and she nods slowly.
Su Yaqing's hand tightens around the phone in the foreground.

Lin Qingyu's expression turns serious and commanding, his elbow on the marble table.
Lin Qingyu's fingers tap the marble tabletop beside the wine bottle.
Lin Qingyu leans forward, the daylight from the window edging his face.
Lin Qingyu's eyes narrow and flick toward the room behind the camera.
Lin Qingyu leans back in the chair with the phone at his ear, his mouth closed, brows lifting impatiently.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: Xu Banxia walks past the marble coffee table to the lounge end of the walnut desk and bends slightly toward Ji Ran. Ji Ran sits in the leather executive chair, and the four applicants stand in a row in front of the desk.
Ji Ran leans back in the leather chair with her long legs crossed. Her eyes sweep coolly along the row of men.
GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, at the lounge end of the row, straightens his back and grins eagerly. The small dumbbell hangs in his hand.
Ji Ran's gaze slides one place along the row, and she taps one finger on the walnut desk.
BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, second in the row, puffs out his chest and plants his fists on his hips.
Ji Ran raises one eyebrow and rests her chin on her hand.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT curls the small dumbbell with both hands. His face is screwed up and his arms shake theatrically.
BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT throws a stiff, awkward punch toward the desk and wobbles off balance.
GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT wrestles his tight grey T-shirt up over his stomach, and the fabric gets stuck at his chest.
SHIRTLESS APPLICANT pulls off his black T-shirt and tosses it aside. He is now bare-chested in orange track trousers. He flexes both biceps and licks his lips.
Ji Ran's hands clench the arms of the black leather executive chair.
Ji Ran covers her forehead with one hand and shuts her eyes.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: Lin Qingyu stands soaked and panting just inside the office door. Xu Banxia holds the door beside him. Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk facing him.
Lin Qingyu pushes wet hair off his forehead. Water drips from his chin as he catches his breath.
Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk. Her eyes travel slowly from his face down his clinging wet T-shirt.
Ji Ran keeps her mouth closed and gives a faint, appraising half-smile. One brow lifts.
Xu Banxia presses her lips together to hold back a laugh and steps out. She pulls the office door shut behind Lin Qingyu.
Ji Ran folds her arms and walks a slow half circle around Lin Qingyu, inspecting him from head to toe. He stands stiffly in the open space in front of the desk.

heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE - DAY

en: Past Lin Qingyu's wet shoulder, Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk with her arms folded and nods once.
Lin Qingyu straightens up to his full height and squares his shoulders.
Ji Ran's eyes flick up and down his body.
Lin Qingyu wipes the sweat from his forehead with the back of his hand.
Ji Ran tilts her head and narrows her eyes.
Lin Qingyu flashes a hopeful, boyish smile.

heading.en: INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE - NIGHT
heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE - NIGHT

en: Lu Shaoze stands at the walnut front door, smooths his slicked-back hair with one hand and raps on the door with his knuckles.
The elevator doors slide open and cool light spills out. Ji Ran steps out with the black handbag on her arm, her red heels striking the stone floor.
Lu Shaoze startles, spins and bumps shoulder-first into Ji Ran. Both stagger and come to a stop beneath the autumn landscape painting, Lu Shaoze at its elevator end and Ji Ran at its front-door end.
Lu Shaoze straightens his jacket, then drawls with a smug, lopsided smile, looking her up and down.
Ji Ran rolls her eyes and lifts her chin coolly, her grip settling on the black handbag strap.
Ji Ran answers with a thin, cutting smile, her head tilted.
zh: Lu Shaoze stands at the walnut front door, smooths his slicked-back hair with one hand and raps on the door with his knuckles.
The elevator doors slide open and cool light spills out. Ji Ran steps out with the black handbag on her arm, her red heels striking the stone floor.
Lu Shaoze startles, spins and bumps shoulder-first into Ji Ran. Both stagger and come to a stop beneath the autumn landscape painting, Lu Shaoze at its elevator end and Ji Ran at its front-door end.
Lu Shaoze straightens his jacket, then drawls with a smug, lopsided smile, looking her up and down.
Ji Ran rolls her eyes and lifts her chin coolly, her grip settling on the black handbag strap.
Ji Ran answers with a thin, cutting smile, her head tilted.

heading.zh: INT. APARTMENT CORRIDOR - NIGHT

en: Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu stand in front of Ji Ran's apartment door, his arm around her waist and the grocery bag full of greens in his other hand. Lu Shaoze faces them on the runner rug and fixes his eyes on Lin Qingyu's arm.
Lu Shaoze jerks his chin at the arm around Ji Ran, and his mouth twists with contempt.
Lin Qingyu smiles brightly, takes his right arm from Ji Ran's waist and holds his right hand out toward Lu Shaoze.
Lin Qingyu keeps his hand extended and smiles sweetly at Lu Shaoze, with the grocery bag full of greens swinging at his side.
Ji Ran slides her eyes sideways toward Lin Qingyu, and the corner of her mouth twitches as she holds back a smile.
Lin Qingyu tilts his head with mock innocence and waves his free hand toward Ji Ran's apartment door.

heading.en: INT. JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
heading.zh: INT. JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

en: Lin Qingyu sits slouched on the pale sofa, and Ji Ran stands across the marble-and-glass coffee table from him with her arms folded and city lights in the windows behind.
Ji Ran looks down at Lin Qingyu with her arms folded and one eyebrow raised.
Lin Qingyu sits up straight on the sofa and lifts his eyes to meet Ji Ran's.
Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran's gaze with a sincere, steady look and a hint of a smile.
Ji Ran's lips part slightly, and her folded arms loosen a little.
Soft glowing light and snowlike flecks drift across the image as Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu look at each other across the coffee table.
